## What and why

<!-- What changes, who benefits, and how does it make their command-line
experience easier or more delightful? A few sentences are usually enough.
Link related issues or requests if available; don't invent demand.

A personal itch is a welcome starting point. Explain why the change belongs
in the shared project. For aliases, describe common workflows they support. -->

## Demo and verification

<!-- For user-facing changes, include before/after screenshots, a GIF,
or a short video. For new features, show an example in use.
If a visual isn't useful, briefly explain why. If it's missing, say so.

Describe checks actually run and their results, relevant versions, and
testing gaps. Distinguish agent-run checks from personal testing.
For documentation-only changes, describe what you checked. -->

## Other notes

<!-- Include only what applies:
- Compatibility concerns or areas needing particular attention.
- How users can discover a feature: README update, example, or shared demo.
- Meaningful AI assistance and its role; basic autocomplete doesn't count.

Delete this section if it isn't needed. -->

<details>
<summary>Submission checklist</summary>

<!-- Check confirmed items with [x]. For conditional items, check them if
the condition doesn't apply. Otherwise, mark inapplicable items "N/A"
with a brief reason. -->

- [ ] The PR title follows the [commit conventions](https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-guidelines) and clearly describes the change.
- [ ] I've searched for existing PRs and confirmed this isn't a duplicate.
- [ ] I've read and followed the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] My code follows the [code style guide](https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/wiki/Code-Style-Guide).
- [ ] I wrote this code or can contribute it under an MIT-compatible license.
- [ ] If I meaningfully used AI tools, I've disclosed their role above.
- [ ] I've included a visual demonstration or explained why a visual isn't useful.
- [ ] I've considered performance and avoided unnecessary work or resource use.
- [ ] I've personally tested the change and described results and limitations above.
- [ ] If I've added aliases, I've explained their usefulness for common workflows.

</details>
